Thursday Bishop's Casual Ride

Milford, OH · Road · Mixed

Thursday Bishop's Casual Ride is a road group ride in Milford, OH. It rolls every Thursday at 6:15 pm from Bishop's Bicycles.

How we know

The Cincinnati Cycle Club's calendar lists the 6:15 PM Bishop's Ride from Bishop's Bike Shop in Milford for Thu Oct 1, 8, 15 and 22, 2026, and none for Oct 29; it describes up to five groups, from casual trail riders to a hilly, intense group, 20 to 40 miles (read Oct 1, 2026).

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: several groups, from casual trail riders to a hilly, intense group; 20 to 40 miles depending on group and time of year. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @cincycycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Bishop's Casual Ride group ride

An easy club ride on the Little Miami Bike Trail and roads around Milford. Fifteen or twenty miles at the pace of the slowest rider. No one left behind.
